_doc: Fragment 'transitions' (prefix tr.): a whoosh at each of the four radial wipes (acts 06-09) and a short whoosh at the two match boundaries (12.0, 34.0). Nothing on the 24.0 cut: the impact fragment owns it. Real Mixkit recordings only (review/audio-sourcing.md).
_wipes: The cue events 'wipe' sit on the first frame of the act (62, 76, 90, 106 s) and carry the pan (x / 960 - 1) of the point the radial curtain opens from. The curtain itself runs (compositions/06..09, GV.since): act06 0.15-1.00 s after the act start (apex 0.575), act07 0.25-1.00 (0.625), act08 0.25-1.00 (0.625), act09 0.00-0.60 (0.30). The whoosh peak is aligned on the MIDDLE of that time window (apex at 50 % of the wipe), so each rule's offset is half the wipe time measured from the cue frame.
_apex: mix.py aligns the 5 ms AMPLITUDE peak of the unpanned recording; qa.py measures the ENERGY apex (50 ms smoothed) of the panned event. For the stereo wind whoosh panned hard (wipes 06 and 08, pan -0.6 / +0.6) the two differ: the apex lies 89 / 75 ms before the amplitude peak (first render: apex 486 / 550 ms for offsets 575 / 625). Those two rules add that measured lead to half the wipe time (0.575 + 0.089, 0.625 + 0.075) so the energy apex, which is what the ear hears, lands on the wipe's middle; the speed recording (centred wipes 07, 09) needs none (-17 ms).
_scope: Task 7 fix (earshot critique v4: 19 of 31 picture events had no new attack within +-100 ms): the match whooshes peak on the picture's cut (11.8 / 33.9 s, 0.2 / 0.1 s before the cue), and the whoosh events nobody sounded now do (collapse 75.5, return 89.5, dark 92.0) along with three picture changes that had no cue (takeover 69.7, clear 103.75 / 105.7, see scripts/export-sound-cues.mjs). act02:vortex (22.0) stays silent under the riser; act10:converge belongs to the impacts fragment.

tr.wipe.wind._about: Mixkit 1168 'Woosh wind' (primary long whoosh, real 0.97, stereo). Used 0.95-2.55 s: the last 0.65 s of the swell, the peak at 1.60 s (0.65 s into the sample) and a 0.5 s fade of the decay. The peak is the alignment point.

tr.wipe.speed._about: Mixkit 1484 'Speeding swoosh' (alternate long whoosh, real 0.98, stereo): front-loaded, peak 0.57 s; used 0.15-1.9 s so the two wipes that use it open faster than the wind ones.

tr.match.air._about: Mixkit 168 'Fast air sweep transition' (primary short whoosh, real 0.88, 0.86 s, peak 0.32 s): the match boundary at 12.0.

tr.acc.swoosh._about: Mixkit 1471 'Cinematic wind swoosh' (alternate 3 short whoosh, real 0.80, 1.45 s, peak 0.43 s), used 0-1.1 s: the window collapsing into the disc at 75.5 (act06:collapse), with the rise before its peak.

tr.acc.dark._about: Mixkit 564 'Soft horror hit drum' low-passed to 220 Hz (a low, round thump, cut at 1.3 s): the plugboard goes dark at 92.0 (act08:dark). Same recording as the sting's soft hit, other trim and level.

tr.hit.air._about: Task 7 fix. Mixkit 168 from 0.28 s: the whoosh's apex and fall with a 4 ms entry, so it starts abruptly ON the picture cut (a swish with an attack). A rising whoosh alone gives the critique's onset detector no new attack (spectral flux of a swell is flat), so the rising whoosh keeps its peak on the cut and this layer adds the attack.

tr.hit.sweep._about: Task 7 fix. Mixkit 2632 from 0.40 s (apex 0.44 s) with a 4 ms entry: the abrupt-start swish for the second match cut and the clears.

tr.acc.click._about: Task 7 fix. Mixkit 1116 'Single classic click' (same trim as ui.click, LP 6.5 kHz): the click as the agent panel settles and the map takes over at 69.7 (the 'VISUALIZE' moment).

tr.acc.pop._about: Task 7 fix. Mixkit 2070 'Light impact on the ground' +5 semitones (same recipe as mo.pop.a): the small pop as the collapsing window disappears into the disc at 75.5.

tr.match.sweep._about: Mixkit 2632 'Whoosh wind sweep' (alternate short whoosh, real 0.87, 1.17 s, peak 0.44 s): the match boundary at 34.0, so the two match cuts do not play the same recording.
